scope: current LiNKsites coding execution and execution-time review

portfolioAccountBinding.authority: Principal statement: exactly one Cursor account serves the entire portfolio, including LiNKharness, LiNKdeveloper and LiNKsites
portfolioAccountBinding.decisionRule: Auto Cost is unavailable for the current portfolio account. Every current coding assignment is explicitly composer_bounded or grok_complex; generic Auto is forbidden.
portfolioAccountBinding.preflightRule: Do not repeat this account capability preflight for LiNKharness, LiNKdeveloper or LiNKsites. Re-run only if the Principal changes the portfolio execution identity or authoritative identity evidence changes.
portfolioAccountBinding.preparedIntentEffect: All PREPARED intents derived from superseded matrices are invalid; derive new route and idempotency identities from this authority after separate execution approval.

transport.namedModels: Cursor SDK/API transport that preserves explicit model parameters and readback
transport.cloudApiV1Rule: Cloud API v1 may be used only if live discovery proves the exact selector and parameters; omission-based default is forbidden
preDispatchEvidence: authenticated Cursor.models.list() or equivalent live catalogue receipt
exact selector and supported parameter values

auto_cost.use: preferred automatic route for normal coding not eligible for composer_bounded and not explicitly complex/long-running
auto_cost.fallback: grok_complex unless effective serving family is Grok, then sol_quality_fallback

composer_bounded.use: only if all work is bounded, simple or repetitive, objectively verified, reversible and has no consequential architecture or live-risk decision

grok_complex.use: explicit complex or long-running coding work

sol_quality_fallback.use: different-family one-hop fallback only after logged Grok model-quality failure
sol_quality_fallback.costPoolReason: task-specific recovery from recorded model-quality failure; never infrastructure recovery

independent_review.use: separate independent worker for consequential exact-candidate review
independent_review.costPoolReason: independent review requires a third-party reasoning family separate from implementation

grok_complex_review_worker.use: one-hop different-family reviewer after logged Opus model-quality failure; still a separate worker

terra_checkpoint.use: distinct IDE checkpoint verification after implementation and independent review
terra_checkpoint.costPoolReason: IDE Development requires Terra checkpoint verification as a separate proof function

failurePolicy.beforeFallback: log route, exact selector, effective model, failure class, reason and timestamp; invalidate the prior PREPARED intent and derive a new idempotency identity
failurePolicy.infrastructureFailure: retry the same exact selector under infrastructure policy; never change model

packets.reason: Harness/provider/domain authority reconciliation is complex and multi-repository

issues.reason: documentation plus one deterministic validator with objective checks and easy rollback
shared-versus-domain authority adjudication affects major subsystems
25 requirements plus CMS, hosting and provider configuration make this complex and multi-system

costForecast.unit: planned worker or packet-coordination assignment; token totals require execution-time budgets
costForecast.fallbackBudget: zero by default; at most one new identity after logged model-quality failure
costForecast.poolPolicy: current coding uses Composer or Cursor Grok because the bound account lacks Auto Cost; Other Models pool only for documented review, Terra verification or one-hop quality recovery
